newsitem.title: USA: AIG Life in pact with American Travellers.
newsitem.headline: AIG Life in pact with American Travellers.

text.p: American International Group Inc said its AIG Life Cos (U.S.) have entered into an agreement with American Travellers Corp subsidiaries to jointly market long-term care insurance policies in the United States.
Under the terms of the agreement, the AIG Life Cos (U.S.) will offer the policies through marketers and general agents recruited by American Travellers.
The AIG Life Cos also will make policies available through its career and brokerage agents, as well as bank-based distribution systems.
American Travellers will provide marketing, administrative and claims support and will share the underwriting risk, AIG said.
The policies will be offered for sale and issued as direct-written insurance contracts of the AIG Life Cos (U.S.).

"With more than 60 million Americans over the age of 55, most in good physical and financial health, the long-term care marketplace has enormous potential," said Robert J. O'Connell, president of the AIG Life Cos (U.S.).
